newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan platinum jewellery demand stays high in '96.
newsitem.headline: Japan platinum jewellery demand stays high in '96.

text.p: Platinum demand from Japan's jewellery industry in calendar 1996 maintained the previous year's record high of 46 tonnes, but that may slip this year, an industry source said on Thursday.

"Against the overall slump in the Japanese jewellery industry, platinum jewellery has posted steady growth because of the popularity of white jewellery among younger people," said a senior official of the Platinum Guild International.
But the official said this year's sales target of 46 tonnes for platinum jewellery would be difficult to reach.
"Meeting our target of 46 tonnes for the jewellery industry this year will be very challenging because of the gloomy economic outlook," he said.
Demand from the jewellery sector accounts for about 70 percent of total platinum demand in Japan.
